title: Brews & Kings
tagline: A city builder about beer and wine.
descriptionShort: A city builder about brewing. Grow wheat and hops, scout the wilderness for pure water and rare ingredients, run your own breweries, and keep the taverns pouring and the king happy.
descriptionLong: You are the King's cellarmaster, holding a royal permit and a patch of wilderness. Build a city to fill the realm's cups with the finest beer and wine. Each run hands you fresh ground and a new King to please.
Grow your grain and raise a brewhouse. Turn the wilderness into an economy strong enough to keep your customers coming back.
Search the world for the purest water and the richest soil. Take on quests to win rare ingredients and lost recipes, then combine them into beers and wines that carry your name.
Every faction wants something from your drinks. Merchants want profit. The Queen wants pride and obedience. Workers want to unwind after a hard day's work. You decide who your drinks are made for.

No run ends empty-handed. New buildings, merchants, and challenges join the world, and the recipes you've discovered stay in your book. Then you lay your first foundation on fresh ground and begin again, under a new King with tastes of his own.
Brews & Kings is made by Scarlet Engineering, a Taiwan studio building systems-driven games where simple rules produce surprising play.
features: Build a city that exists to brew and ferment: fields, vines, brewhouses, winepresses, cellars, and taverns.
Explore for what the realm cannot grow: the purest water, the richest soil, rare ingredients, and lost recipes.
Combine your discoveries into beers and wines of your own, and give them your name.
You can't please everyone: merchants, the Queen, and workers each want something different from your drinks.
Survive the trial that ends every run: a royal festival, a freezing winter, or a spirit that drains your people.
Begin again: new buildings, merchants, and challenges join the world, and your recipes stay in your book.
about: Scarlet Engineering is an indie studio that engineers emergence: systems-driven games where simple rules produce surprising play.
Brews & Kings is the studio's take on the city builder: a medieval kingdom that runs on beer and wine.
